disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure or refusal to comply with the rules and requirements of the Division of Professional Regulation
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Certificates issued under this chapter may...be suspended or revoked by the director of labor and training, upon failure or refusal of the licensee to comply with the rules and requirements of the division of professional regulation or for other sufficient cause.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Other sufficient cause as determined by the board and director
disciplinary_grounds.quote: suspended or revoked by the director of labor and training, upon failure or refusal of the licensee to comply with the rules and requirements of the division of professional regulation or for other sufficient cause.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to perform electrical work in accordance with applicable city or town rules and requirements, or failure to correct defective work after notice
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure of any licensee to do that work in that manner, or his or her failure or refusal to correct the work with reasonable promptness after notice by local inspection or enforcement authorities...shall be grounds for suspension or revocation of the license

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to perform electrical work in accordance with the National Electrical Code or division-specified rules
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure of any licensee to do the work in that manner shall be considered grounds for suspension or revocation of the license

disciplinary_grounds.description: Making any misstatement as to experience or other qualifications on a license application
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Any person applying for a license and making any misstatement as to his or her experience or other qualifications...shall be subject to the penalties prescribed in § 5-6-32.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in the electrical business or work without having complied with the licensing provisions
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Any person, firm, association, corporation, or employee of any person, firm, association, or corporation...entering upon or engaging in the previously defined business and work, without having complied with the provisions of this chapter, shall be assessed penalties pursuant to § 5-6-32.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Refusing, impeding, or obstructing entry and free access to any part of a building by an authorized investigating official
disciplinary_grounds.quote: If any owner, occupant, or other person refuses, impedes, inhibits, interferes with, restricts, or otherwise obstructs entry and free access to any part of the building, structure, or premises by an authorized investigating official of the division of professional regulation...the chief administrator of the division may: Revoke or suspend any license

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to file all required tax returns or pay all taxes due to the state
disciplinary_grounds.quote: That notification of delinquent tax status shall constitute grounds to refuse to re-issue, renew, extend, or deny any license issued under any title of the general laws.

definition_quote.value: "Electrical contractor" means a corporation, firm, or person, who or that, by the employment of journeypersons, performs the work of installing, maintaining, servicing, and testing wires, conduits, apparatus, fixtures, and other appliances for carrying or using electricity for light, heat, or power purposes exclusive of low-voltage wiring for heating or refrigeration equipment for service, maintenance, and installation.
